title: Team Lead Product Management (f/m/x)
description:
About Patronus
Patronus develops smart emergency call technology that gives seniors greater safety and independence in their daily lives. More than 25,000 people already rely on us. As a Berlin-based healthcare startup backed by financially strong investors, we’re growing rapidly—and in this role, you’ll help drive that growth.
As Team Lead Product Management (f/m/x), you’ll lead our product management team of three and report directly to our CTPO. You’ll set the strategic direction for our product areas while working hands-on in the web area. What defines us as a team: short decision paths, a high degree of ownership and real room to shape things.
What you'll do
 - Leadership & Coaching: Lead the product management team, support individual growth through regular 1:1s and create the right conditions for great collaboration
 - Strategy & Roadmap: Shape the product strategy together with the CTPO, own the overarching roadmap for Web, Mobile and Platform, and prioritize in line with business goals and team capacity
 - Web Product Ownership: Take hands-on ownership of the webshop, customer portal and back office, including roadmap and backlog
 - Discovery & Requirements: Translate user research and customer interviews into user stories and a prioritized backlog
 - Data-Driven Decisions: Analyze user behavior, KPIs and user feedback; derive and validate hypotheses
 - Processes & UX: Turn complex customer processes into well-designed workflows and an outstanding user experience
 - Stakeholders & Interfaces: Act as the bridge between stakeholders, Engineering and QA
 - Quality: Define and enforce quality standards across products, test features hands-on, support QA and assist the customer support team
 - Delivery: Drive execution across all product areas, spot dependencies between Web, Mobile and Platform early, remove blockers and ship reliable releases
 - AI & Agentic Development: Use AI for prototyping and UI generation in your daily work and establish agentic ways of working across the product team, from discovery to spec writing and testing
What you bring
 - 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally with a focus on web applications
 - Solid leadership experience in product management, ideally in a startup environment with fast iterations and shifting requirements
 - Experience building roadmaps and actively driving delivery, from prioritization to release
 - A data-driven approach based on KPIs, analytics, user behavior and user feedback
 - Ideally, know-how in e-commerce and webshops
 - Experience with UX/UI design and prototyping in Figma; ideally also with Hotjar, Miro, Mixpanel and Jira
 - Hands-on experience with AI and agentic development in your daily product work (prototyping, UI generation, agentic workflows), or a strong desire to build this up with us
 - Excellent stakeholder management skills
 - Fluent English and solid German skills
What we offer
⚖️ Fair from the Start: We’ll give you our best possible offer right away—we start with the number that other companies only present at the end of negotiations.
🏢 Work Location: Work from home up to 2 days a week, plus an air-conditioned office with a view of the Spree in the heart of Friedrichshain
📚 Growth: A €500 annual learning & development budget, a clear career framework, and 360° feedback to support your professional growth
🤝 Team Spirit: We celebrate successes together at regular company events and quarterly team events, with a €50 budget per person for special experiences (e.g., escape rooms, cooking classes, or game shows)
🏖️ Vacation: Up to 30 days of vacation (starting with 26 in the 1st year and 28 in the 2nd year) 
🧘 Fitness & Leisure: Up to 50% off Urban Sports Club, employee discounts via Corporate Benefits, restaurant deals, and a Family & Friends coupon for the Patronus watch
🚲 Transportation: 30% discount on the "Deutschlandticket" and discounted bike leasing
🥤 Food & Beverages: Free soft drinks & a bean-to-cup coffee machine, a granola station, quarterly company brunches, and weekly healthy snacks
💻 Hardware: Choice between a MacBook and a Lenovo 
🌍 Impact: A product with genuine social value, plus one volunteer day per year
The simple way to live safely. We are Patronus.
We’re more than just a provider of smart emergency watches—we develop technologies that empower people to live independently: We create a world where aging is delightful.
This is made possible by our revolutionary Patronus watch: At first glance, it doesn’t look like an emergency watch, yet it allows users to easily call for help anytime, anywhere. In doing so, we ensure safety and literally save lives. It’s our gateway to improving the lives of older adults, their loved ones, and caregivers—and making the healthcare system more effective. So that in the future, everyone can live their life the way they want to.
Does this sound like the perfect job for you?
We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!
Even if you don’t tick every box, we encourage you to apply.
Patronus is an employer that promotes equal opportunity and diversity. We strive to create a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for all our employees, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disabilities and abilities of any kind, physical appearance, social background, marital status, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

title: Staff Product Manager - Ledger Wallet (Contractor)
description:
Job type: Contractor/Freelance
Duration: 1 year
Location: Paris, France
About Ledger
We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.
At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.
The team:
As a Staff Product Manager on Ledger Wallet, you own a full product domain end to end, for example Earn or Swap/Buy/Sell. You are accountable for its vision, roadmap, adoption and business results.
We are looking for a strong, autonomous PM. You will turn a complex and regulated space into simple, safe experiences that users trust and come back to, and that grow Ledger's revenue.
You lead a cross-functional squad of engineers, designers and a delivery manager, working closely with Data, Business Development, Legal, Compliance, Marketing and external partners.
What you’ll be doing:
 - Own your domain's vision and roadmap. Define where the domain goes next and turn it into a clear, prioritized quarterly plan that balances growth, platform scalability and user trust.
 - Grow adoption and revenue. Understand your funnel inside out, remove friction, and move the metrics that matter: conversion, retention, volume and revenue.
 - Decide with data. Use Mixpanel and our analytics stack to define KPIs, find drop-offs, run experiments and prioritize on evidence, not opinion.
 - Know your users and market. Stay close to users through research and feedback, and track competitors so Ledger stays the most relevant and safest option.
 - Ship end to end. Write sharp PRDs, take initiatives through our product gates within quarterly planning, and lead your squad from discovery to launch and iteration.
 - Communicate with clarity. Produce decision-ready roadmaps, vision docs and dashboards that leadership and partners can act on without further editing.
 - Work with partners. Evaluate, integrate and manage third-party providers, and shape commercial and rev-share models with Business Development.
 - Navigate regulation with Legal and Compliance. Build products that are compliant by design across markets, and turn constraints into clear product decisions.
 - Shape strategy beyond your domain. Contribute to the Ledger Wallet vision and annual roadmap, and connect your domain to the rest of the product: onboarding, engagement, device and money movement.
 - Lead cross-squad initiatives. Drive complex, multi-team bets end to end, aligning dependencies, trade-offs and timelines across squads and business lines.
What we’re looking for:
 - Data-driven. You are at ease with data analysis and bring an approach that is both business- and user-centric: numbers guide your decisions, and you never lose sight of the user behind them.
 - Problem solving. You understand a problem in depth before solving it. You dig into root causes, challenge assumptions and frame the right question before jumping to solutions.
 - Leadership. You bring teams with you, act proactively and focus on impact. You know how to defend a product vision, including in front of business stakeholders.
 - Autonomy from discovery to delivery. You own your scope end to end, from framing the opportunity to shipping and iterating, without hand-holding.
 - At least 8 years of product management experience, ideally on consumer products at a scale-up or high-growth tech company.
 - Proven staff-level impact: you have led cross-team initiatives and influenced strategy beyond your own scope.
 - A track record of owning a product domain end to end, with measurable impact on adoption, retention or revenue.
 - Experience on transactional or financial products (fintech, payments, trading, banking or crypto) is a strong plus.
 - Comfort working with external partners and in regulated environments.
 - Fluent English; French is a plus.
We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

title: Entrepreneur in Residence für work2stay (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS · 100 % remote · bis
description:
Wir suchen keinen angestellten Geschäftsführer, der ein fertiges Unternehmen übernimmt.
 Wir suchen den Unternehmer, der work2stay aus einer bereits aufgebauten Ausgangslage in ein finanziertes und wachsendes SaaS-Unternehmen führt.
 work2stay ist die KI-gestützte Pre-Check Engine für internationale Rekrutierung. Aus CV, Qualifikation und Unterlagen entsteht ein strukturiertes Kandidatenprofil mit Readiness-Report, offenen Nachweisen und den nächsten organisatorischen Schritten – als digitales Quality Gate vor dem Behördenprozess. (Work2Stay)
 Das MVP ist live und wird aktuell mit Pilotpartnern getestet. FLYACTS und ein erfahrener Venture Partner haben Problem, Geschäftsmodell, Produkt und erste Marktzugänge aufgebaut.
 Dein erster Meilenstein ist klar: Du sicherst die nächste Finanzierungsrunde. Danach übernimmst du work2stay langfristig als Founding CEO und baust insbesondere Marketing, Vertrieb, Organisation und Team auf.
 Fachkompetenz im internationalen Recruiting ist hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung. Diese Seite kann perspektivisch durch eine fachlich starke Co-Founderin aus unserem Pilotumfeld ergänzt werden.
 Deine Stärke liegt im Aufbau einer SaaS-Company:
 Kapital gewinnen. Vision erzählen. Kunden überzeugen. Menschen führen. 
 Aufgaben
 Du entwickelst Finanzierungsstrategie, Investment Story, Pitch Deck und Finanzplan und führst den Prozess von der Investoren-Pipeline über Pitches und Due Diligence bis zum Closing.
 Du erzählst die Vision von work2stay so, dass Investoren, Kunden, Partner und zukünftige Mitarbeiter Vertrauen fassen und Energie entwickeln.
 Du gewinnst persönlich die ersten zahlenden Kunden und baust daraus eine wiederholbare Marketing- und Vertriebsstrecke.
 Du schärfst Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Pricing und Packaging anhand realer Marktreaktionen.
 Du übernimmst nach der Finanzierung die vollständige CEO-Verantwortung für Strategie, Zahlen, Team und Stakeholder.
 Du gibst dem Produkt die Richtung aus Kundengesprächen und Verkaufsdaten. Du musst nicht selbst Produktmanager oder Entwickler sein.
 Qualifikation
 Du hast bereits ein Unternehmen gegründet oder ein junges Unternehmen in einer CEO- oder vergleichbaren unternehmerischen Rolle geführt.
 Du hast als Gründer, CEO oder federführend verantwortliche Person bereits mindestens 1 Mio. Euro externes Eigenkapital eingeworben und den Prozess von Investorensuche und Pitch bis Term Sheet und Closing selbst geführt.
 Du verstehst B2B SaaS und hast bewiesen, dass du Produkte vermarkten, verkaufen und zu wiederkehrenden Umsätzen entwickeln kannst.
 Marketing und Vertrieb sind für dich keine Funktionen, die du nur steuerst. Du kannst selbst positionieren, pitchen, Einwände bearbeiten und abschließen.
 Du kannst eine große Vision erzählen, ohne zu übertreiben. Menschen vertrauen dir, weil du Begeisterung mit Klarheit und Substanz verbindest.
 Du besitzt hohe Eigenverantwortung, Entscheidungsstärke und Belastbarkeit. Unsicherheit lähmt dich nicht, und Rückschläge verarbeitest du schnell.
 Du analysierst ausreichend, um gute Entscheidungen zu treffen – aber nicht so lange, bis das Momentum verschwunden ist.
 Du kannst Menschen führen, Vertrauen schaffen und unterschiedliche Stakeholder für ein gemeinsames Ziel gewinnen.
 Du identifizierst dich mit der Vision von work2stay und bist bereit, das Unternehmen nach der Finanzierung langfristig und mit voller Verantwortung zu führen.
 Du kannst die erste Phase bis zur Finanzierung wirtschaftlich selbst tragen.
 Du kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch.
 Benefits
 Die Rahmenbedingungen transparent vorweg
 Bis zum erfolgreichen Closing der vereinbarten Finanzierungsrunde erhältst du kein Gehalt und keine Gesellschaftsanteile.
 Mit dem Closing erhältst du 25 % Beteiligung an work2stay vor Verwässerung durch die Runde . Der Zeitraum ab deinem Einstieg wird auf das vierjährige Vesting angerechnet.
 Wird das Funding-Milestone innerhalb des vereinbarten Zeitraums nicht erreicht, endet die Beteiligungszusage ohne Anteilserwerb.
 Nach erfolgreicher Finanzierung ist ein angemessenes CEO-Gehalt Bestandteil des Finanzplans.
 Schick uns dein LinkedIn-Profil und beantworte drei Fragen:
 Welche Finanzierungsrunden hast du federführend abgeschlossen?
 Welches digitale oder SaaS-Geschäftsmodell hast du bereits kommerziell aufgebaut?
 Warum sollte work2stay in fünf Jahren ein relevantes Unternehmen sein?
 Ergänze bitte ein Video von maximal drei Minuten, in dem du die work2stay-Vision so erzählst, wie du sie einem potenziellen Investor erzählen würdest.
 Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Product Manager Awareness & Lead Acquisition West
description:
As **Product Manager Awareness & Lead Acquisition West**, you own the awareness and lead-generation journey across the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Finland and our .com domain.
You translate our global segmentation and targeting approach into market plans and customer-facing campaigns, and turn that into a roadmap your squad can deliver against.
You’ll work closely with the East team for one consistent marketing approach, and with Client Acquisition on lead handover through to conversion.
**What you’ll do**
* Define a multi-quarter vision for Awareness & Lead Acquisition in the West markets.
* Adapt LYNX’s global STP approach into market-specific plans, strategies and tactics.
* Own and prioritise a living roadmap for acquisition capabilities.
* Drive initiatives from discovery through implementation.
* Analyse customer behaviour, campaign performance and competitor activity.
* Own OKRs measured by brand awareness, MQLs, cost per lead, conversion rate, ROMI and estimated CLV.
* Ensure marketing and acquisition capabilities comply with privacy and financial promotion requirements.
**Who you are**
You’re a product professional with genuine marketing craft and a feel for the Dutch/Belgian market.
* 3–5 years in product management with proven, measurable business outcomes.
* Strong experience with digital and brand marketing, acquisition funnels and customer research.
* Data-driven mindset: marketing analytics, KPI management, self-serve BI or SQL.
* Strong stakeholder management across Marketing, Engineering, Sales and Operations.
* Experience operating in regulated contexts (privacy, security, KYC/AML/MiFID).
* Fluent English and Dutch, spoken and written.
**Nice to have**
* Experience within fintech, brokerage or financial services.
* Deep SEO, SEA and paid-media expertise.
* Experience with CRM, marketing automation and attribution modelling.
**What we offer**
* A competitive salary based on experience.
* Flexible working hours at our office in the heart of the city.
* A fixed 13th-month salary.
* Pension scheme for NL/DE/BE.
* Travel expense reimbursement.
* An annual training budget of €2,000, freely allocated to your professional development.
* Team outings, social drinks, and an annual weekend trip with the entire team.
**Who we are**
*“LYNX helps you invest in yourself.” “Working at LYNX means joining the LYNX family.” “The development opportunities make LYNX the best place to work.”*
This is what our employees say about LYNX, and it reflects exactly what we aim to offer: an environment where you can get the best out of yourself.
From our offices in Amsterdam, Ghent, Berlin, and Prague, we work every day to provide private and professional clients with the best trading opportunities through a fast, user-friendly, and reliable platform.
LYNX is an international FinTech company where around 300 colleagues contribute to client success across Europe in an informal, collaborative, and growth-oriented environment.
We’re an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified and eligible candidates without attention to gender identity/expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation/identity, disability or neurodiversity.

title: (Senior) Product Manager
description:

title: (Senior) Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
About the role 
 We're looking for a (Senior) Product Manager (m/f/d) who gets their energy from understanding customers and markets, and who turns what they learn into product improvements that ship.
 You'll work on different topics depending on priority, and you'll take each one the whole way: from discovery, to a well-shaped proposal, to rollout, to checking whether it actually made a difference. You own your topics end to end and work closely with engineering and design to bring them to life.
 Sounds like your kind of role? Here's what we're looking for:
 A strong researcher ready to grow into broader product ownership
 An experienced product manager 
 Someone who has led product teams before and wants to be hands-on again
 What you'll do 
 Discover what matters. Talk to customers, analyze product usage and track the market to uncover unmet needs, underserved audiences and new use cases.
 Build real relationships with customers. Recruit interview partners yourself and keep those relationships going, both inside and beyond our customer base.
 Run your own numbers. Write your own queries, question data quality and rule out alternative explanations before drawing conclusions.
 Make the case. Turn opportunities into product proposals that clearly lay out the problem, the evidence, your solution, the trade-offs and the success metrics. Ground them in our product and technical reality.
 Challenge and be challenged. Present your proposals to the team and sharpen them through feedback. Push back on our product direction when the evidence says so.
 Drive delivery. Work through the details with design and engineering until your initiative ships. Meanwhile, start shaping your next topic.
 Own the rollout. Plan rollouts, bring in beta customers, and draft positioning and messaging together with Marketing and Brand.
 Close the loop. After launch, check adoption and customer value, and feed what you learn back into the product.
 What you'll bring 
 Hands-on customer research experience. You've run and synthesized customer interviews. You can explain how you get from observations to solid insights and decisions.
 You genuinely enjoy talking to customers. You build relationships that last longer than a single interview.
 Analytical judgment. You're comfortable with data, you ask the right questions, and you look at results critically.
 A product point of view. You form a well-reasoned position even when things are uncertain. You stand by it, and you change it when new evidence comes in.
 Visible impact. You've made a clear personal contribution to something substantial. That could be a feature, a positioning, a strategy, a product you built yourself, or expertise you've shared publicly.
 Strong written and async communication. You're comfortable working this way. We provide templates and guidance for writing product proposals.
 AI is part of how you work. You use it naturally to make ideas tangible and to speed up your own work.
 Initiative and curiosity. You're open to coaching, critique and pushback, and you give pushback too.
 Heyflow is recognized as a TOP company by LinkedIn and Kununu (German Glassdoor). Join us NOW! 
 Heyflow is the leading all-in-one lead generation platform in the market, combining every essential tool into a single, highly flexible no-code solution. Since our founding in 2020, we've empowered the marketing efforts of both fast-growing scaleups and established enterprises. Our diverse customer base includes Fortune 500 companies like Adecco Group, Cisco, and Credit Agricole, as well as fast growing scaleups such as RocketMortgage and 1KOMMA5°.
 Why Heyflow? 
 Just like fingerprints, each of us is one-of-a-kind, and that's why we believe in catering to your individual needs. Dive into the details below to learn more about the additional perks that our team absolutely loves: We’ve partnered up with 12 services and providers for you to choose from. Public transportation, vacation and lunch bonuses? No problem. Gym membership, daycare and a bikeleasing subscription? We’ve got you covered. You pick, we take care, you enjoy.
 We are advocates of diversity & inclusion and so, we encourage people of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, gender identity or expression, backgrounds and experiences to consider applying for this role.

title: Technical Product Manager (d/f/m) - People Intelligence Apps
description:
Our Story
 Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.
Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.
 The Opportunity
 As our People Intelligence/Apps Technical Product Manager within the People Strategy & Insights team, you'll be a critical part of developing our agentic enablement platform and responsible for building and shipping the People applications that power how we hire, develop, and grow our team — from workforce planning tools to AI-augmented performance and org design solutions.
Reporting to our Director of People Strategy & Insights and collaborating closely with People Partners, Leaders, FP&A, IT, and AI and Platform Engineering, you'll translate complex People domain challenges into elegant, scalable products that make a real difference in how we operate. At Taxfix, we're building an AI-native company — and this role sits right at the heart of that mission.
 Your Responsibilities
 Develop a deep understanding of the employee as “Builder” concept, and map the requirements different parts of the organisation have to unlock the capability of Engineers and non-Engineers to ship agentic workflows.
 Design and implement AI-augmented tools and human-AI collaboration patterns, experimenting with emerging techniques to push the boundaries of what's possible in People operations.
 Build, iterate, and continuously improve People applications using no-code and low-code platforms such as Claude Code, Notion, n8n, Google Cloud Apps, and other AI tools — owning the full product lifecycle from concept through delivery and optimisation.
 Lead the continued adaption of Product mindset and ways of working across the People function, including the development and on going refinement of the People Products Roadmap.
 Translate stakeholder needs into a prioritised People applications roadmap, balancing day-to-day operational demands with longer-term strategic initiatives and a clear build-vs-buy framework.
 Build and maintain integrations across the People tech stack — including HiBob, Ashby, Peakon, and Postgres — ensuring seamless data flows, strong data integrity, and reliable automation via n8n.
 Lead change management for new applications and features, creating documentation, training materials, and enablement sessions, then gathering feedback to iterate rapidly.
 Partner with PSI leadership, People Partners, Workforce Planners, and FP&A, while collaborating with IT and Engineering to ensure all solutions meet IT security and privacy standards.
 Your profile
 You bring 5+ years of experience in technical product management or a closely related role, with a proven track record of building and shipping internal tools end-to-end.
 You have hands-on experience building with AI tools such as Claude, GPT, or Google AI Studio, and you think naturally about how to design effective human-AI collaboration patterns.
 You are a curious PM that is not afraid to challenge the status quo in a pragmatic and constructive way.
 You are thinking in systems, understanding the economical aspect of internal processes and products and how those can create value.
 You are technically fluent, comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, SQL, and cross-system data flows, and you know when to bring in Engineering versus when to build it yourself.
 You have a product mindset: you manage roadmaps, prioritise ruthlessly, and deliver incremental value in fast-paced environments, all while keeping the end user's experience front and centre.
 You are highly proficient with no-code and low-code platforms, Notion, n8n, AppSheet, Google Cloud Apps, or similar, and you're comfortable designing data models that support complex business logic and reporting.
 Experience in People or HR tech, workforce planning, or org design is a strong plus, as is a background in high-growth startup or scale-up environments where ambiguity is the norm, not the exception.
 Why Taxfix?
 A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.
 Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.
 A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.
 Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.
 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.
 A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.
 Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.
 Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.
 Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

 At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. title: Senior Product Management Builder (d/f/m)
description:
Our Story
 Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.
Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix, Steuerbot and TaxScouts, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.
 Your Opportunity
 AI is shifting how the best products get built. The handoffs between product, design, and engineering are slowing us down. The companies moving fastest are doing it with people who own the full loop, from the user problem to the shipped feature, without losing the thread.
At Taxfix, we’re rebuilding our R&D organization around this idea. We call these people builders .
A Builder has a primary craft, one they’re genuinely excellent at, but they don’t stop there. They stretch across product, design, and engineering as the situation demands, using AI to cover the gaps. They’re accountable to outcomes, not job descriptions.
Taxfix has put €5 billion back into our customers’ pockets and we aren’t stopping there. We operate in Germany, Spain, and the UK, and we’re in the middle of a genuine AI transformation in how we build and how we’re organized.
Assume there’s no designer to give you a Figma file. No engineer to hand the spec to. The magic is knowing what to build, why, and in what order, then making it happen. If building the thing sounds more natural to you than describing it, this role is for you.
 Your Responsibilities And Decisions
 Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped product. Write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, and get it in front of users, with as few handoffs as possible. Own the full loop.
 Compress research, synthesis, and spec-writing from weeks into hours. You reach for AI tools not because you’ve been asked to, but because they faster make you faster in delivering high quality outcome. You know when to trust the output, when to edit it, and when to reject it. Use AI as a force multiplier.
 You structure fuzzy problems, identify what should and shouldn’t be built, and move forward when there are dozens of possible directions. The magic is in the trade-offs, not the feature list. Turn ambiguous ideas into things users can trust.
 You collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders on AI-related product work, translating AI concepts, capabilities, limitations, and outputs into clear product decisions. You work effectively in hybrid human-AI teams. Work in small, focused teams.
 You know the metric your team is trying to move. You measure your week by what changed in user behaviour, not by how many tickets moved to Done. Be accountable to outcomes, not roadmaps.
 You give feedback directly, to anyone, regardless of level. You raise blockers early and in the open. Push back when something’s wrong. Team player who raises the bar.
 Your Profile
 Your craft
 5+ years experience in Product Management (ideally in fintech or B2B). You’ve shipped things that real people use, and you can point to the metric that moved when you did.

 You bring an entrepreneurial and independent mindset. You are excited about spotting opportunities and then acting on them.

title: Team Lead Product Management (f/m/x)
description:
About Patronus
 Patronus develops smart emergency call technology that gives seniors greater safety and independence in their daily lives. More than 25,000 people already rely on us. As a Berlin-based healthcare startup backed by financially strong investors, we’re growing rapidly—and in this role, you’ll help drive that growth.
As Team Lead Product Management (f/m/x) , you’ll lead our product management team of three and report directly to our CTPO. You’ll set the strategic direction for our product areas while working hands-on in the web area. What defines us as a team: short decision paths, a high degree of ownership and real room to shape things.
 What You'll Do
 Leadership & Coaching: Lead the product management team, support individual growth through regular 1:1s and create the right conditions for great collaboration
 Strategy & Roadmap: Shape the product strategy together with the CTPO, own the overarching roadmap for Web, Mobile and Platform, and prioritize in line with business goals and team capacity
 Web Product Ownership: Take hands-on ownership of the webshop, customer portal and back office, including roadmap and backlog
 Discovery & Requirements: Translate user research and customer interviews into user stories and a prioritized backlog
 Data-Driven Decisions: Analyze user behavior, KPIs and user feedback; derive and validate hypotheses
 Processes & UX: Turn complex customer processes into well-designed workflows and an outstanding user experience
 Stakeholders & Interfaces: Act as the bridge between stakeholders, Engineering and QA
 Quality: Define and enforce quality standards across products, test features hands-on, support QA and assist the customer support team
 Delivery: Drive execution across all product areas, spot dependencies between Web, Mobile and Platform early, remove blockers and ship reliable releases
 AI & Agentic Development: Use AI for prototyping and UI generation in your daily work and establish agentic ways of working across the product team, from discovery to spec writing and testing
 What You Bring
 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally with a focus on web applications
 Solid leadership experience in product management, ideally in a startup environment with fast iterations and shifting requirements
 Experience building roadmaps and actively driving delivery, from prioritization to release
 A data-driven approach based on KPIs, analytics, user behavior and user feedback
 Ideally, know-how in e-commerce and webshops
 Experience with UX/UI design and prototyping in Figma; ideally also with Hotjar, Miro, Mixpanel and Jira
 Hands-on experience with AI and agentic development in your daily product work (prototyping, UI generation, agentic workflows), or a strong desire to build this up with us
 Excellent stakeholder management skills
 Fluent English and solid German skills
 What We Offer
 ⚖️ Fair from the Start: We’ll give you our best possible offer right away—we start with the number that other companies only present at the end of negotiations.
 🏢 Work Location: Work from home up to 2 days a week, plus an air-conditioned office with a view of the Spree in the heart of Friedrichshain
 📚 Growth: A €500 annual learning & development budget, a clear career framework, and 360° feedback to support your professional growth
 🤝 Team Spirit: We celebrate successes together at regular company events and quarterly team events, with a €50 budget per person for special experiences (e.g., escape rooms, cooking classes, or game shows)
 🏖️ Vacation: Up to 30 days of vacation (starting with 26 in the 1st year and 28 in the 2nd year) 
 🧘 Fitness & Leisure: Up to 50% off Urban Sports Club, employee discounts via Corporate Benefits, restaurant deals, and a Family & Friends coupon for the Patronus watch
 🚲 Transportation: 30% discount on the "Deutschlandticket" and discounted bike leasing
 🥤 Food & Beverages: Free soft drinks & a bean-to-cup coffee machine, a granola station, quarterly company brunches, and weekly healthy snacks
 💻 Hardware: Choice between a MacBook and a Lenovo 
 🌍 Impact: A product with genuine social value, plus one volunteer day per year
 The simple way to live safely. We are Patronus.
 We’re more than just a provider of smart emergency watches—we develop technologies that empower people to live independently: We create a world where aging is delightful.
 This is made possible by our revolutionary Patronus watch: At first glance, it doesn’t look like an emergency watch, yet it allows users to easily call for help anytime, anywhere. In doing so, we ensure safety and literally save lives. It’s our gateway to improving the lives of older adults, their loved ones, and caregivers—and making the healthcare system more effective. So that in the future, everyone can live their life the way they want to.
 Does this sound like the perfect job for you?
 We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!
 Even if you don’t tick every box, we encourage you to apply.
 Patronus is an employer that promotes equal opportunity and diversity. We strive to create a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for all our employees, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disabilities and abilities of any kind, physical appearance, social background, marital status, age, or religion (or lack thereof).

title: Referent*in der Geschäftsführung / Chief of Staff (m/w/d)
description:
Stellendetails
 Mit der Strategie 2030 starten wir 2027 in eine neue strategische Ausrichtung, für die wir sieben Schwerpunkte festgelegt haben. Es gilt nun, die Strategie in die Praxis zu übersetzen und unsere Organisation so aufzustellen, dass wir die Ziele gemeinsam und wirksam erreichen. Dafür schaffen wir eine neue Stabsstelle: Als rechte Hand der Geschäftsführung und zentrale Schnittstelle innerhalb des Verbandes sorgst du dafür, dass wir die richtigen Dinge tun und sie gut auf den Weg bringen. Du hast die Agenda und Prioritäten im Blick, schaffst Orientierung, verbindest Menschen und Themen und sorgst dafür, dass wichtige Vorhaben vorankommen und Entscheidungen umgesetzt werden.
Du nimmst an den Sitzungen der Geschäftsleitung teil und sorgst für einen guten Informationsfluss und verbindliche Absprachen. Du bereitest Sitzungen und Strategieklausuren vor, strukturierst Themen und Entscheidungen, dokumentierst Ergebnisse und behältst die Umsetzung vereinbarter Maßnahmen im Blick. Als Schnittstelle zum Präsidium unterstützt du zudem die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Geschäftsführung/Geschäftsleitung und ehrenamtlicher Verbandsspitze.
Die Umsetzung unserer Strategie 2030 ist ein Hauptschwerpunkt: Du behältst die sieben strategischen Schwerpunkte im Blick, entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Verantwortlichen geeignete Steuerungs- und Erfolgskriterien und sorgst dafür, dass Fortschritte sichtbar und messbar werden.
Dabei ist die Digitalisierung des Verbands ein wesentlicher Hebel: Das SOinDE-Portal und verlässliche Daten sollen uns helfen, Fortschritte, Engpässe und Handlungsbedarf frühzeitig zu erkennen und fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Du arbeitest insgesamt eng vernetzt mit den Verantwortlichen der strategischen Schwerpunkte sowie mit den Landesverbänden und vielen Teams der Bundesgeschäftsstelle zusammen (insbesondere Portal, Bildung und Sponsoring). Ausgewählte Landesverbände begleitest du als Pilotregionen, beispielsweise beim Aufbau unserer „Angebotsbörse“ oder des CRM-Systems.
Die Position ist als Stabsstelle angelegt, bietet aber unmittelbare Einblicke in die strategische Führung und Steuerung des Gesamtverbandes und einen entsprechend großen Gestaltungsspielraum.
 Aufgabenbeschreibung 2. Geschäftsführung und Organisation wirksam unterstützen Bei allen Projekten begleitest du die Einführung, schulst interne und externe Nutzer*innen und erstellst geeignete Hilfen wie Anleitungen, Erklärvideos und Antworten auf häufige Fragen. Du probierst außerdem neue Technologien, beispielsweise KI-Werkzeuge, aus, um Abläufe und Zusammenarbeit effizienter zu gestalten, ohne Abstriche bei der Qualität zu machen.
 Strategie-Umsetzung steuern und messbar machen
 Du treibst die Strategie-Agenda voran, planst und koordinierst feste Abstimmungsrhythmen, z.B. Quartals- und Halbjahres-Gespräche.
 Du behältst den Fortschritt aller sieben Schwerpunkte im Blick, sammelst Kennzahlen und Daten ein – wo möglich automatisch. Du spielst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau einer verlässlichen Datenquelle für den ganzen Verband, auf die wir uns perspektivisch stützen können.
 Du bereitest Entscheidungen für Geschäftsführung und Geschäftsleitung vor. Du berätst dabei zur digitalen Unterstützung der Strategie, zur Umsetzung und zur Erfolgskontrolle.
 Du bindest alle Beteiligten ein und informierst den Verband regelmäßig über den Stand der Strategie, z.B. nach einem Halbjahres-Termin.
 Du bist die rechte Hand der Geschäftsführung und hast deren Agenda, Prioritäten und zentrale Vorhaben im Blick. Du identifizierst Handlungsbedarfe und bringst Themen proaktiv voran.
 Du koordinierst die Geschäftsleitungsrunde, bereitest deren Sitzungen inhaltlich und organisatorisch vor, dokumentierst und hältst Entscheidungen, Verantwortlichkeiten und nächste Schritte nach.
 Du bereitest Strategieklausuren, Workshops und weitere wichtige Formate vor und begleitest sie inhaltlich und organisatorisch.
 Du verbindest Themen, Menschen und Bereiche innerhalb der Organisation, sorgst für Transparenz über wichtige Vorhaben und Abhängigkeiten und unterstützt eine gute bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit.
 Du bist Schnittstelle zum Präsidium: Du koordinierst die Vorbereitung relevanter Themen und Unterlagen, sorgst für einen verlässlichen Informationsfluss und unterstützt die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Haupt- und Ehrenamt.
 Du erkennst, wo Abläufe, Abstimmungen oder Entscheidungswege verbessert werden können, und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten pragmatische Lösungen. Dein Anspruch: Was wir tun, zahlt auf unsere Organisationsziele ein; wir setzen Aufgaben dabei möglichst reibungslos und effizient um.
 Strategische und Digitalprojekte leiten Du leitest ausgewählte Projekte, mit denen wir in den nächsten Jahren wichtige Datenlücken schließen und unsere digitale Infrastruktur weiterentwickeln:
 Aufbau einer „Angebotsbörse“ für SOinDE: Als Projektleitung des Pilotprojekts stellst du die Nutzer*innen in den Mittelpunkt und findest gemeinsam mit den Pilotregionen heraus, welcher Nutzen tatsächlich entsteht. Du entwickelst Anreiz- und Geschäftsmodelle, die dauerhaft funktionieren und sich auf weitere Landesverbände und Mitglieder übertragen lassen. Die fachlichen Anforderungen beschreibst du so, dass das Portal-Team sie gemeinsam mit dir in technische Anforderungen übersetzen kann.
 Aufbau eines CRM-Systems (Kontaktpflege-System): Gemeinsam mit dem Portal-Team entwickelst du die Funktionen zur Kontaktpflege im SOinDE-Portal. Du testest Funktionen und Abläufe für verschiedene Anwendungsfälle – beispielsweise Mitgliedergewinnung, Kooperationspartnerschaften und Sponsoring – gemeinsam mit dem Team Sponsoring, den #ZusammenInklusiv-Projekten und ausgewählten Landesverbänden.

title: Senior Electrical Project Manager – Data Centers (f/m/d)
description:
Job title : Senior Electrical Project Manager – Data Centers (f/m/d)
 Reference number : 44225
 Locations : Frankfurt am Main (This position can be based in any Arcadis office location in Germany, while the onsite projects will primarily be located in the Frankfurt and Rhine-Main area).
 Working hours: Full-time
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
 Role description:
 For our Project Management Team Technology in the Places Business Unit, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Electrical Project Manager (f/m/d) to support data center construction projects.
The position is located within our global Places business unit. Together with our customers around the world, we create, promote, and optimize intelligent, safe, and sustainable places where people live, work, learn, and succeed. Places influence people's quality of life—whether it’s housing, shops, workplaces, schools, hospitals, businesses, research and development facilities, or data and distribution centers. People and communities thrive when their living, working, recreational, and play spaces are designed and operated to best meet their needs.
 Role accountabilities:
 As a Senior Electrical Project Manager (f/m/d), you take full operational responsibility for the planning, coordination, and execution of electrical infrastructure in demanding data center projects. You ensure that electrical systems are designed to be reliable, energy-efficient, and redundant, while fully complying with all safety-related and regulatory requirements. In this role, you combine technical expertise with pragmatic project management: leading teams, managing interfaces with other disciplines, and ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
 Coordinate and manage the planning and design of electrical systems in data centers, ensuring efficiency, redundancy, and the highest safety standards.
 Lead, motivate, and technically guide a team of engineers and technicians to develop innovative solutions for electrical infrastructure.
 Develop, review, and approve electrical designs for data centers and other critical facilities, incorporating energy-efficient technologies and current industry trends.
 Collaborate closely with architects, mechanical/MEP engineers, and other specialists to deliver integrated, holistic design solutions.
 Ensure compliance with all relevant standards, technical regulations, and safety requirements (e.g., VDE, IEC, NFPA 70E, DIN EN50600).
 Manage budgets, resource planning, and monitor costs, schedules, and quality; provide regular reports to management and stakeholders.
 Coordinate planning and implementation within multidisciplinary teams and liaise with external service providers, suppliers, and contractors.
 Support the construction phase by overseeing tests, commissioning (FAT/SAT), inspections, and handover to the operator.
 Identify risks, initiate countermeasures, and contribute to value engineering measures to optimize cost and performance.
 Qualifications & Experience:
 First and foremost, you share our passion for improving quality of life and for customer satisfaction. You take pride in the role you play in reshaping the world around you and understand the importance of teamwork. You are technically skilled, have relevant experience in managing building and infrastructure projects, and bring with you:
 Degree (Bachelor’s, Master’s, or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Automation Technology, or a related field.
 Minimum of 5 years’ experience in the planning and leadership of electrical systems, ideally with a focus on data centers or large-scale infrastructure projects.
 Solid knowledge of energy-efficient electrical systems and current industry trends.
 In-depth understanding of relevant laws, standards, and safety regulations (notably VDE, IEC, and fire protection).
 Proficient in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, EPLAN) and other planning tools.
 Strong leadership capabilities with experience in guiding and developing technical teams.
 Excellent communication skills, ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and engage with internal and external partners.
 Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken.
 Willingness to travel domestically and internationally on a regular basis.
 If you are enthusiastic about this position but do not meet all the requirements, you should apply anyway. We value diverse skills and experience, and maybe you are exactly the right person for our team.
 Why Arcadis?
 We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
 Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
 We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. title: Senior Product Manager, Data & Platform (SaaS / Remote)
description:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it? 
 The Mission: 
 Publitas turns retailers' static catalogs into interactive, shoppable digital experiences for brands across Europe and North America. We're a small, fully remote product organisation.
 You'll be hands-on: in the codebase, in the data, prototyping with AI and shipping yourself. The default assumption is that you can figure it out, not that someone else will figure it out for you.
 What you'll own 
 A product area with its own customers, roadmap and tech lead. You decide what gets built, in what order, and you carry the outcome. [Addendum per team: two or three lines on the area, its customers, and the one big decision waiting for them.]
 Your first 90 days 
 Day 30 - You know your key stakeholders, have a baseline understanding of the product area and its challenges, and a working relationship with the team. You understand how the product is built and where the data lives well enough to form your own view, not one handed to you. A first version of the roadmap is on the table.
 Day 60 - You've made your first major call - a scope cut, a kill, a bet - grounded in evidence and explicit about what would change your mind. You've found the gap between what was decided in your area and what actually ships, and closed at least one. You've put something real in front of customers or the team that you built yourself - a prototype, a working change - rather than waited for.
 Day 90 - Your roadmap is trustworthy: Now, Next and Later are current and nobody has to ask what's happening. You've shipped your first prototype yourself, and your team is working AI-first.
 What we need from you 
 Builder depth. You understand how software is built well enough to prototype against live services with AI tools, pull your own data, and ship without waiting for an engineer.
 Evidence over summaries. You've made expensive go/no-go calls - a migration, a vendor choice, killing a product - from the evidence underneath, and you can explain what you decided, why, and what would have changed your mind.
 Senior product experience. You've scaled a B2B product and know what that takes: the retention politics, the roadmap pressure from customer-facing teams, the trade-offs nobody wants to make.
 Lived AI experience. You've shipped real work where AI did part of it and you can tell us exactly where it went wrong. You think in workflows and systems, not prompts.
 Proactivity in an async team. You set priorities, make trade-offs, and decide what ships.
 Excellent written English. We're fully remote and async-first; most of your influence travels in writing.
 What We Offer You to Win 
 Compensation : Your salary is geo-bracketed to your location, with flexibility within the bracket based on your experience and what you bring to the role. A clear, performance-based path for progression follows from there.
 Real Ownership: Full autonomy over priorities, sequencing, and what ships within your pillars, plus the mandate to define how an entire product organization works with AI.
 True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.
 Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.
 Modern Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.
 Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.
 Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.
 At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output. 
 Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are "AI-curious"; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.
